verseText: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us...
meaning: God is able to do way more than we could ever even think about asking for. His power is beyond our wildest imaginations!

recall.question: How much is God able to do?
choices: Immeasurably more than we ask or imagine

meaning.question: What does this verse emphasize?
choices: God's power is beyond our imagination
We should never ask God anything
God only works through strong people

application.prompt: Bring a big request to God, remembering that His power is greater than what you can imagine.
